text: APPROVE. The extracted `RuleReplaces` and `TargetsRemoved` keep the original skip conditions (the negation of `Key != && !Universal` is `Key == || Universal`), the same declaration order and short-circuiting, and no new usings are needed. The cognitive complexity of each method is now well under 15 (roughly 9 for `RuleReplaces`, about 2 for `TargetsRemoved`), and I see nothing that should break the build.
